title: Rewrite exercise
description: Take a badly written internal message and fix it: request buried at the bottom, no date, and a slipped deadline mentioned in passing.

tasks.title: Where does the ask go?
tasks.description: Two questions on the structure of a clear message.

questions.questionText: Where should the request go in a work message?

options.text: In the first line, before the context
At the end, after the reasoning

questions.questionText: A deadline has slipped. When should you say so?

options.text: As soon as the date is at risk
On the day it was due, with a plan
Once you know the new date for certain

tasks.title: The rewrite
tasks.description: Rewrite the message so the ask is in the first line, the delay is stated plainly, and it is short enough that a busy reader finishes it.
tasks.hint: Keep the deadline. Cutting it loses more marks than length gains.

correct.answer: Can you confirm by Thursday whether we hold order 4192? We will miss Friday on the original plan — detail below.

partial.answer: Please confirm by Thursday about order 4192. Background follows.

incorrect.answer: Following up on my earlier note regarding the order, I wanted to reach out and see whether there had been any movement on this at your end.
